title: Five-Year Prescription Period for Administrative Financial Claims
instructions: أنت محامٍ يقدّم المشورة لعميلك. اطّلع على المستندات المرفقة: وقائع العميل ونصوص المواد والمبادئ القانونية ذات الصلة. ثم أعدّ مذكرة مشورة قصيرة باسم `advice-note.md` تجيب عن الأسئلة المطروحة في وقائع العميل، وتبيّن السند القانوني لكل نقطة. استند إلى المستندات المرفقة وحدها، ولا تفترض وقائع أو نصوصًا غير واردة فيها. اكتب باللغة العربية.

criteria.title: Five-Year Prescription Period
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that bonuses owed to state employees transfer to the public treasury (الخزانة العامة) if no claim is made within five years from the date they fall due. FAIL if the note does not mention the five-year period from the date of entitlement or does not mention the transfer to the public treasury.

criteria.title: Administrative or Judicial Claim
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that a claim includes both a judicial claim and an administrative claim equally. FAIL if the note limits the claim to only one type, whether judicial or administrative, or omits either type.

criteria.title: Two Conditions for Application
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note indicates that two conditions are required for application: the existence of a financial right owed by the state, and the failure to claim it for five years. FAIL if the note mentions only one of the two conditions or omits both.

criteria.title: Transfer to Treasury by Force of Law
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that entitlements transfer to the public treasury (الخزانة العامة) by force of law (بقوة القانون) upon the passage of five years without a claim being made. FAIL if the note does not specify that the transfer occurs by force of law or does not specify the five-year period without a claim.

criteria.title: Prohibition on Administration's Acknowledgment or Payment
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note states that the administration is prohibited from acknowledging the entitlements or paying them after the passage of five years from the date they fall due. FAIL if the note does not mention the prohibition on both acknowledgment and payment after five years from the date of entitlement.

criteria.title: Expiry Date Calculation
criteria.match_criteria: PASS if the note determines that the five-year period had expired before Ahmed's claim in March 2021, rendering the claim inadmissible. FAIL if the note does not establish that the five-year period elapsed prior to March 2021 or does not conclude that the claim is inadmissible.

review.notes: Verified C-001 through C-006 against Egypt's five-year prescription rules (Civil Code Article 375 and Article 50 of the Financial Regulation for Budget and Accounts) and State Council Fatwa jurisprudence on transfer of unclaimed entitlements to the public treasury by force of law.
